title: Where did I get this?
description: This mod adds the ability to see where you got an item.
body:
Where Did I Get This? adds a history line to your item tooltips that displays the exact coordinates, structure, and method of how you found or obtained your items.

Unique Item History: Every single item keeps its own distinct history.

Detailed Origins: Displays the exact structures your items came from (like Trial Chambers, Ancient Cities, or Spawner Dungeons), alongside mob drops, crafting, and mined block coordinates.

Singleplayer Only: This mod does not work on multiplayer servers.
